"""Local self-test for task_template.md: placeholder contract + the snippet compiles.

Mirrors adapter._task_template_error + the live `str.format(...)` call, then extracts every
python code block from the rendered message and compile()s it. Catches the two defects that
would silently score every task 0. Not part of the capability; delete-safe.
"""
import re
import string
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REQUIRED = {"instruction", "spreadsheet_path", "spreadsheet_content",
            "instruction_type", "answer_position", "output_path"}
OPTIONAL = {"max_turns"}
COMMENT_RE = re.compile(r"<!--.*?-->\s*", re.DOTALL)

text = COMMENT_RE.sub("", Path("task_template.md").read_text(), count=1).strip() + "\n"

found = {f for _, f, _, _ in string.Formatter().parse(text) if f}
missing, unknown = sorted(REQUIRED - found), sorted(found - REQUIRED - OPTIONAL)
assert not missing, f"MISSING placeholders: {missing}"
assert not unknown, f"UNKNOWN placeholders: {unknown}"

rendered = text.format(
    instruction="I", spreadsheet_path="p", spreadsheet_content="c",
    instruction_type="Cell-Level Manipulation", answer_position="A1:B2",
    output_path="o", max_turns=30,
)

blocks = re.findall(r"```python\n(.*?)```", rendered, re.DOTALL)
assert blocks, "no python code block survived rendering"
for i, b in enumerate(blocks):
    compile(b, f"<block{i}>", "exec")

print(f"OK — placeholders {sorted(found)}; {len(blocks)} python block(s) compile; "
      f"{len(rendered.splitlines())} rendered lines")
